headword: {二人三脚|ににんさんきゃく}

definitions.explanation: A race in which two runners have their neighbouring legs tied together, a fixture of school sports days.
Two people or groups cooperating step by step toward the same goal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{二人三脚|ににんさんきゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We did a three-legged race at the sports day.

examples.japanese: {二人三脚|ににんさんきゃく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{転|ころ}んで→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧しまった。
examples.english: We fell over in the three-legged race.

examples.japanese: {二人三脚|ににんさんきゃく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{速|はや}く→速い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{走|はし}れない→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: In a three-legged race, you can't run fast unless the two of you are in step.

examples.english: The couple has kept the shop going together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦コーチ→コーチ：03844_koochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{二人三脚|ににんさんきゃく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{金|きん}メダル→金メダル：20781_kinmedaru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}した→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。

notes:
Sense 2 is common in news and speeches, usually as {二人三脚|ににんさんきゃく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (hand in hand, as a team). Read ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧にん, not ふたり.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二人三脚|ににんさんきゃく}で〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do … together, as a team
- ⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧{二人三脚|ににんさんきゃく}: husband and wife working together

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧: cooperation — the general word
